value.summary: The change removes the `next_state` field (which held an `EpisodeState`) and adds `watermark` (moved up from inside the former `EpisodeState`) and `round_start` set to `u64::MAX`. This matches the `HiveTurn` struct's new shape after the introduction of concurrent turn support. All fields present in the signature are plausible; the constant `u64::MAX` aligns with the documented intent of a single-turn round boundary. No concrete failure path or regression is visible.
